nom: The Crème Shop Sanrio Hello Kitty Klean Beauty Intensive Overnight Moisture Gelee Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls her skin extremely dry and flakey and another who is dry from swimming and running, consistently report it left their skin soft, supple and well hydrated, even through winter or after exercise.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who describes it as naturally oily, mostly report it hydrates without adding grease or shine, though one reviewer found it made her face a bit too oily for her taste.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including those who describe themselves as acne-prone, report it leaves skin soft and hydrated without added oiliness or stickiness, and helps rehydrate drier patches.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: two who describe themselves as having sensitive, oily-combination skin report it left their skin soft and hydrated without irritation, while another titled her review Not for sensitive skin after it made her cheeks break out and turn red.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe strong, lasting hydration, waking up with soft, plump or supple skin, and several call it more effective than pricier products, especially during dry winter months. A couple found it only mildly hydrating, with one calling it not super hydrating but good enough.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers say it calms redness and irritation, including one using it specifically after a harsh routine to relieve redness. Against this, one reviewer reports the opposite: it made her cheeks break out and turn red.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers managing post-acne marks, scarring or discoloration report visible fading and a clearer, more even tone with regular use, which a few credit to the niacinamide; no reviewer reports spots or pigmentation getting worse.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention acne or breakouts report it doesn't trigger new blemishes and several say it visibly cleared existing acne or reduced breakouts, including on acne-prone or combination skin. One reviewer is a clear dissent, reporting it made her cheeks break out.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin say it hydrates without adding grease or shine, with a couple specifically noting it was the first moisturizer that didn't leave them looking oily. One reviewer is a dissent, saying it left her face a bit too oily along with a fragrance that felt like too much.

aspects.libelle: Jelly-like gel texture that melts in
Slightly sticky feel right after applying
Hello Kitty packaging is a big draw
Glass jar shatters easily if dropped
Great value next to pricier products

extraits.texte: I love the texture, the scent, all of it! Just makes my cheeks break out and turn red! Heart broken!

I got this mask on a whim to share with my boyfriend last winter, thinking it was more of a face mask than jelly moisturizer. It was not a winner for me personally, but my boyfriend absolutely loved it and actually used up 3 jars since. It makes my face a bit too oily and the fragrance is a lot for me. Maybe it's so good for him because it hydrates his stubbly facial hair too, seriously making him SHINE. Haven't been able to find it in store for a few months, but I'm hoping I can nab some for him soon!

I got this moisturizer not expecting anying grand but any time that I apply this it makes my skin nice and soft. Plus it doesn't have any comedogenic ingredients. For reference I have combination acne prone skin and I use skin care products like Retnoid which can make the drier parts of my face even more dry. I will say that this product has a unique texture, kind of like jelly but it doesn't bother me and it just melts into your skin. It does have a very light strawberry scent but it's not overpowering at all. Overall I recommend this product if you're looking for a new moisturizer.

Initially I bought this for the packaging because I buy everything Sanrio, but I found that it really does work - my skin is normally extremely dry and flakey, but after using this my skin feels SO soft/supple and it even leaves a nice glow. I love it and plan on purchasing it again 100%.
Anything from the Crème Shop is a yes, but this product does wonders. I'm suffering with a lot of post blemish pigmentation and it has dramatically calmed it down. Highly recommend

I'm admittedly a Hello Kitty fan, so that was one of the main reasons I wanted to purchase this lol but it has actually turned out to be well worth it. I have naturally oily skin, and this didn't make my face feel extra greasy at all...in fact when I wake up in the morning my skin feels soft and not oily at all. Also, it smells SO GOOD!

This is the only moisturizer that I use daily. It moisturizes skin, but doesn't make your face feel sticky, and unlike some moisturizers, this doesn't cause acne on my skin and i actually noticed a little decrease in acne when using this moisturizer. This is also made with clean products and no harsh chemicals so unless you are allergic to a specific ingredient in the product, it works well for sensitive skin. I also really love the strawberry scent of the mask; it's not strong, but it's sweet.
